observations: The original flat salmon rail bands now show warm coral shoulders with controlled broad highlights and a readable softly shaded lower roll. The slate deck has more convincing slat shoulders and troughs. Rails and deck remain distinct instead of merging into a slab.

The near-black original supports are replaced by wider beveled honey-wood legs, darker shaped shoes, restrained vertical grain and small attached brass pegs. They communicate a stable crafted structure and remain readable against dark backgrounds at 55 and 32 pixels/cell. This is useful native modeling improvement inside the envelope, not an unnecessary preservation of old part counts.

The four facings use one coherent material/light configuration and match the later approved native family reference. No preferred horizontal highlight direction or directional ground shadow was found. The deck-only native animation remains orderly through all 24 phases with exact closing evidence, without flicker, swimming, broken corners, muddy intersections or missing surfaces.

EEE repeats and compatible ENE/NEN runs meet continuously. There is no visible gap, doubled rail edge, alpha hairline, dark RGB seam or phase discontinuity. Their independently assembled sprites agree with actual connected geometry through the approved Godot consumer at 128, 55, 32 and fractional contexts.

At intended sizes the palette and functional silhouette remain clear. Small grain/peg details simplify at phone size, while the rails, deck rhythm and supports survive. No material dead spot was found in any required facing.

Full-image differences were reviewed separately from join metrics. The largest differences are tiny support-foot boundary shading residuals, not hidden deck/rail seams. The enlarged crops and intended-size pairs show no material defect. Alpha remains exact throughout all full images and joins.
remainingDifferences: The native result uses the approved family's restrained coral/slate/honey shading rather than the ImageGen target's stronger glossy highlights and heavy gold hardware. It still visibly improves softness, volume and craft over the original.

Gold terminal collars, overhanging caps, target framing drift and faint target stray alpha are intentionally absent to preserve open modular contacts and registration. The source weak geometry and old part count were not treated as aesthetic constraints.

Independent versus native connected full-image support-foot shading differs by at most 10 RGB levels at 128, 3 at 55 and 2 at 32; at most 22, 4 and 1 pixels respectively exceed 1 level in a pair. The exact joinROIs never exceed 1 RGB level, and no alpha pixel differs. These small nonseam shading residuals are accepted.
